candidates.title: August day-shift output peaks 1581 pcs on 2026-08-28
candidates.rationale: Line chart shows daily trend over shift-days 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-31. The day_total column (good pcs) reveals a clear ramp-up from 711 pcs on 08-03 to a peak of 1581 pcs on 08-28, with multiple zero-days (Obon/holidays) visible as flat segments at the baseline.

candidates.title: August day-shift new vs rework split dominated by new builds
candidates.rationale: Bar chart shows the split between new_total and rework_total per day. The data profile confirms rework_total is negligible (max 28 pcs on 08-19, avg 0.9), while new_total accounts for nearly all output (avg 645.2 vs 0.9), making this a closed pattern of pure new-build production.

candidates.title: August day-shift daily rollup with exact values
candidates.rationale: Table provides exact values for day_total, new_total, rework_total, and net_sec_total for all 31 rows. This is necessary because the target_total is constant zero (no baseline), and exact values are required to verify the negligible rework and net seconds per day.

questions.q: Why does output drop to 30 pcs on 2026-08-22 after a ramp to 1502 pcs on 08-21?
questions.why: Unexplained sharp dip with no stated gap (Obon/holidays) behind it; needs downtime cause.
